# IMQServiceOptions.drainTimeout property

Milliseconds a drain waits for in-flight requests before giving up on them and exiting anyway. Ignored unless [IMQServiceOptions.drain](/api/rpc/latest/rpc.imqserviceoptions.drain/) is on.

**Signature:**

```typescript
drainTimeout?: number;
```

## Default Value

the `IMQ_DRAIN_TIMEOUT` environment variable, itself defaulting to [DEFAULT\_IMQ\_DRAIN\_TIMEOUT](/api/rpc/latest/rpc.default_imq_drain_timeout/) (4000)

## Remarks

The wait is always bounded: whatever has not finished by then is abandoned, logged, and the process exits `0` regardless.
